steps.mac1: Open Litma.dmg from your Downloads folder.
steps.mac2: Drag Litma into the Applications folder.
steps.mac3: The first time, right-click Litma in Applications and choose Open, then Open again.
steps.win1: Open Litma-win.exe from your Downloads folder.
steps.win2: If Windows shows “Windows protected your PC”, click More info, then Run anyway.
steps.win3: Follow the installer. Litma opens when it's done and adds a desktop shortcut.
steps.linux1: Move Litma-linux.AppImage from Downloads to a folder you keep, such as your home folder.
steps.linux2: Right-click it, open Properties → Permissions and tick “Allow executing file as program” (or run chmod +x on it).
steps.linux3: Double-click it to open Litma. If it doesn't start, install libfuse2 from your software centre.

agree.title: Before you post
agree.intro: The community works when everyone feels safe to write. Please agree to these, in short:
agree.p1: Be kind. Discuss the writing, never attack the writer.
agree.p2: No hate or mockery of anyone's religion, caste, community, race, region, gender, age or ability.
agree.p3: No threats, harassment, sexual content, or anything illegal.
agree.p4: Share only your own writing, or quote others briefly with credit.
agree.p5: Keep private details private: no phone numbers, addresses or other people's personal information.
agree.p6: Posts are your own words. Litma's moderators can close or remove posts and stop anyone from posting.
agree.check: I have read and agree to the Community Guidelines and the Terms of Use.
